brief.audience: developers installing and updating prebuilt binaries from the command line, plus users of the local `eget web` console
brief.metaphor: one verified binary extracted from many release assets and placed where it runs: an archive box whose lower-right corner is scooped open, with the extracted chip just outside it

rejected_directions.name: concept-2-tray
rejected_directions.why: chip settling into an open tray: reads as a generic bin/download glyph (distinction 2/5)

rejected_directions.name: concept-3-slot-e
rejected_directions.why: letterform e with the chip leaving its mouth: distinctive but needs horizontal room and the letterform carries the mark alone (reduction 3/5)

variants.note: text-only wordmark, paths only (no <text>, no symbol)
app-icon tile: same geometry scaled up on a solid #0f1720 tile so the mark holds at 16px

primary.use: symbol, wordmark lockup symbol on light surfaces (matches --accent in web/src/styles.css, 4.9:1 on #f6f7f9)

dark_surface.use: symbol on dark surfaces, app-icon tile mark (matches the console sidebar brand teal, 7.4:1 on #0f1720)

ink.use: wordmark on light surfaces, app-icon tile background (matches the console sidebar background)

exports.app_icon: exports/eget-favicon-*.png, favicon.ico (16/32/48), favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png (180, flattened on #0f1720), android-chrome-192x192.png, android-chrome-512x512.png, site.webmanifest
exports.readme_lockup: exports/eget-lockup-1280.png and exports/eget-lockup-dark-1280.png, width 1280, used by the README <picture> block for light and dark themes
exports.web_console_icons: internal/app/web/icons/ holds the browser subset served by the console (copied from this directory; regenerate with the same render command, then copy favicon.ico, favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, android-chrome-192x192.png, android-chrome-512x512.png and site.webmanifest)

notes: No trademark clearance has been performed. The mark is a generic geometric composition (rounded square with a scooped corner plus a chip) and could resemble package/archive marks in the wild; commission a professional similarity search before commercial registration.
Concepts in concepts/ are exploration artifacts scored during design; concept-1-peel is the selected direction (its geometry is what final/ ships).
